---
title: "Show a table and a chart in a notebook"
jupyter: php
---

Summarize a phibble data frame in one notebook cell and plot the result in the
next.

Requires the `php` kernel from [Installation](../install.qmd). The pipe tab
needs PHP 8.5, and the method chain runs on PHP 8.3 and later.

## Setup

Create a Composer project and start JupyterLab in it:

```bash
mkdir mileage && cd mileage
composer require phpstats/phibble phpstats/phplyr phpstats/phiz
~/.venvs/juphyter/bin/jupyter lab
```

Create a notebook with the PHP kernel from the launcher. The data is the `mpg`
dataset that ships with phiz: 234 cars, with each car's class and its highway
mileage in miles per gallon (`hwy`).

## Cells

- The kernel loads `vendor/autoload.php` from the notebook's directory or the
  nearest directory above it, so cells need no `require`.
- A `use` statement applies to its own cell and every later one.
- phplyr's `round()` replaces PHP's built-in `round()` in the cells after the
  import.

```{php}
use Phibble\DataFrame;
use Phiz\Datasets;
use Phiz\Plot;
use function Phplyr\{phplyr, group_by, summarize, arrange, desc, n, mean, round};
```

A cell's last value is its output. A phibble data frame is shown as a table.

::: {.panel-tabset group="syntax"}

## PHP 8.5+

```{php}
$mpg = DataFrame::fromRows(Datasets::mpg());

$byClass = $mpg |>
    group_by('class') |>
    summarize(cars: n(), hwy: round(mean('hwy'), 1)) |>
    arrange(desc('hwy'));

$byClass;
```

## PHP 8.3–8.4

```{php}
$mpg = DataFrame::fromRows(Datasets::mpg());

$byClass = phplyr($mpg)
    ->groupBy('class')
    ->summarize(cars: n(), hwy: round(mean('hwy'), 1))
    ->arrange(desc('hwy'))
    ->get();

$byClass;
```

:::

Variables persist across cells, so the next cell plots `$byClass`. A phiz plot
is shown as a chart.

```{php}
Plot::of($byClass)
    ->aes(x: 'class', y: 'hwy')
    ->col()
    ->labs(x: 'Vehicle class', y: 'Mean highway mpg');
```

See also: [Rich output](../get-started.qmd#rich-output),
[JupyterLab](../jupyter.qmd), [phplyr](https://phplyr.phpstats.org), and
[phiz](https://phiz.phpstats.org).
